opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards to the USA (UK Scholars)

amount.raw: Generous monthly stipends varying by award (e.g. Elon $5,000/month + housing; Rutgers $5,000/month + housing + travel grant up to £1,500; RCS England £2,275/month; National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship stipend for 5-12 months)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK citizens (resident anywhere except the US), or Irish citizens normally resident in Northern Ireland. Non-UK citizens based in and committed to a UK career may be considered if ineligible through their country of citizenship. Must hold a PhD in a relevant subject (or be due to complete before grant start) or an equivalent professional degree/experience. Preference given to those without extensive prior US experience.
opportunities.summary: The only scholarships available to UK-based academics and other professionals to lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university. Grant periods typically 3-6 months. Includes partner awards: All Disciplines, Elon University, Royal College of Surgeons of England, Rutgers University-Newark, Royal Society of Edinburgh, and the Fulbright-National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards for UK professionals

amount.raw: Generous monthly stipends varying by award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based mid-late career professionals; British citizens (with the same citizenship framework as UK Scholar Awards).
opportunities.summary: Scholarships for mid-late career professionals partnered with professional or charitable bodies, as well as Awards in specific disciplines, to research or teach in the USA. The page states applications for academic year 2025-26 are closed and will open for academic year 2026-27 in August.
